보라색.ex: 보라색 우산을 잃어버려서 하나 다시 샀어요.
보라색.x: I lost my purple umbrella, so I bought another one.
보라색.e: 보라 is probably borrowed from Mongolian; 색 means 'color'.

학원.x: I go to an English academy after work.
학원.e: Literally 'study institute'; a huge part of Korean after-school life.
학원.t: Use 다니다 for attending regularly: 학원에 다니다.

복사기.ex: 복사기가 고장 나서 복사를 못 했어요.
복사기.x: The copier broke, so I couldn't make copies.

둥글다.x: That child has a round, cute face.
둥글다.e: Related to 동그랗다 'round'; the darker vowels give a bigger, fuller feel.
둥글다.t: The ㄹ drops before ㄴ, so 'round face' is 둥근 얼굴, not 둥글은 얼굴.

집세.ex: 이번 달 집세를 아직 못 냈어요.
집세.x: I still haven't paid this month's rent.
집세.t: Pronounced [집쎄] — the ㅅ becomes tense after ㅂ.

사회적.ex: 환경 오염은 큰 사회적 문제가 되었습니다.
사회적.x: Environmental pollution has become a big social problem.
사회적.e: 사회 'society' + -적 '-al': -적 turns nouns into adjective-like words: 경제적, 국제적.
사회적.t: -적 words go directly before nouns (사회적 문제) or take 인/으로: 사회적인 활동, 사회적으로.

겁.ex: 저는 겁이 많아서 밤에 혼자 못 나가요.
겁.x: I scare easily, so I can't go out alone at night.
겁.t: Key phrases: 겁이 많다 'scare easily', 겁이 나다 'get scared', 겁을 주다 'scare someone'.

상금.ex: 말하기 대회에서 일등을 해서 상금을 받았어요.
상금.x: I won first place in the speech contest and got prize money.

웹툰.ex: 저는 출근할 때 휴대폰으로 웹툰을 봐요.
웹툰.x: I read webtoons on my phone on my way to work.
웹툰.e: Korean-made blend of English 'web' + 'cartoon', now used in English too.
웹툰.t: Many popular K-dramas are adapted from 웹툰, so fans often say 원작 웹툰 'the original webtoon'.

용의자.ex: 경찰은 어제 용의자의 얼굴을 언론에 공개했어요.
용의자.x: Yesterday the police released the suspect's face to the media.
용의자.e: Literally 'person under suspicion'; -자 = person who does it: 과학자, 운전자.

되도록.forms: 되도록 + verb (되도록 빨리); 되도록이면 = if possible
되도록.x: Please contact me as soon as possible.
되도록.e: From 되다 'to become, be possible' + -도록 'so that'.

선뜻.x: My friend readily lent me money.
선뜻.t: Also common negated: 선뜻 대답하지 못했어요 'I couldn't answer right away.'

당연히.x: You studied hard, so naturally you'll pass.
당연히.e: Literally 'properly so': what ought to be.

동일하다.x: The two products are identical in quality.

동질감.m: sense of kinship, feeling of sameness
동질감.ex: 같은 고향 사람을 만나면 동질감을 느껴요.
동질감.x: I feel a sense of kinship when I meet someone from my hometown.
동질감.e: Literally 'feeling of the same nature'. -감 = feeling: 책임감, 자신감.

명분.x: That war had no justification from the start.
명분.e: Literally 'name and role': a reason that looks right in public.

덕담.m: words of blessing, good wishes (esp. at New Year)
덕담.x: On Lunar New Year's Day, my grandfather gave us his good wishes.
덕담.t: Pronounced [덕땀]. Elders give 덕담 after the New Year's bow (세배), e.g. 올해도 건강해라.

글램핑.ex: 텐트를 칠 필요가 없어서 글램핑이 편해요.
글램핑.x: Glamping is convenient because you don't have to pitch a tent.
글램핑.t: Korean glamping sites usually provide a ready-made tent with beds, heating and a barbecue grill, so you just bring food.

응원가.ex: 야구장에서 팬들이 다 같이 응원가를 불러요.
응원가.x: At the ballpark, the fans all sing the cheering songs together.
응원가.t: At Korean baseball games each player has his own 응원가, sung by the whole stand and led by the cheering squad.

법조계.x: He worked in the legal profession for thirty years.
법조계.e: -계 = field or circles: 법조계, 정치계, 연예계.
법조계.t: 법조인 refers to judges, prosecutors and lawyers collectively.

대서특필.ex: 그 선수의 우승은 모든 신문에 대서특필되었어요.
대서특필.x: The athlete's victory was splashed across every newspaper.
대서특필.e: Literally 'write big with a special brush' — giving news huge coverage.
대서특필.t: Usually used as 대서특필되다 (to be splashed across the headlines) or 대서특필하다.

학자금.ex: 학자금 대출을 갚느라 월급이 거의 남지 않아요.
학자금.x: Paying back my student loans leaves almost nothing of my salary.

청출어람.x: The student became more famous than the teacher—a real case of the student surpassing the master.
청출어람.e: Literally 'blue comes out of indigo' — yet ends up bluer than the plant.

대의명분.ex: 그들은 전쟁을 시작하기 위한 대의명분을 찾았습니다.
대의명분.x: They looked for a just cause to start the war.
대의명분.e: Literally 'great righteousness, proper name and role.'

유효성.x: The new drug's efficacy was confirmed in clinical trials.

승부수.ex: 회사는 신제품 출시로 마지막 승부수를 띄웠습니다.
승부수.x: The company made its final decisive move by launching a new product.
승부수.e: From the game of baduk: literally 'the move that decides win or loss'.
승부수.t: Common verbs: 승부수를 던지다 or 승부수를 띄우다 (to make a bold, decisive move).

치외법권.ex: 대사관은 치외법권 지역이라서 경찰이 함부로 들어갈 수 없습니다.
치외법권.x: An embassy is extraterritorial ground, so police can't just go in.
치외법권.e: Literally 'the right to be outside the governing law'.

병세.m: patient's condition, state of an illness
병세.x: Grandpa's condition suddenly got worse starting last night.

세포핵.ex: 세포핵 안에는 유전 정보가 들어 있습니다.
세포핵.x: Genetic information is stored inside the cell nucleus.
세포핵.e: Literally 'cell core'; 핵 also means 'nuclear', as in 핵무기.

굽어보다.m: to look down on (from above); to look kindly down upon
굽어보다.x: I stood on the mountaintop and looked down on the village.
굽어보다.e: 굽다 'to bend' + 보다 'to look' — bending down to look below.

곡진하다.ex: 그는 곡진한 편지로 감사의 마음을 전했어요.
곡진하다.x: He expressed his gratitude in a heartfelt letter.
곡진하다.e: Literally 'covering every bend fully' — attentive to every detail.

보드랍다.ex: 갓 태어난 아기의 볼이 정말 보드라워요.
보드랍다.x: The newborn baby's cheeks are so soft.
